DataContractId.description:
A namespaced contract id matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$`,
for example `ezsdr.stream.cf32`.

Rule: SB-1, SC-2.

Finite.description:
A finite 64-bit float: NaN and the infinities are refused, so OV-15's
canonicaliser never meets one.

Rule: SB-4, OV-15.

anyOf.description: A signed 64-bit integer, written as an exact decimal by the canonicaliser (OV-15).

Scalar.description:
The one scalar type: a `Value`'s scalar, a constraint's and a capability's value,
and a `DataContract` attribute (SB-4, SB-5, SC-2).

Carries no tag (OV-13's carve-out): a scalar is the value an author wrote, not a
two-field object wrapping it.

Rule: SB-4, SB-6, SC-2.

description:
A registered data contract: an id, a fixed attribute map, and the set of
producer contracts it accepts without conversion.

Rule: SC-2, SC-4.

attributes.description:
Attributes fixed at registration, for example `bytes_per_sample`. The Kernel
stores these and never interprets them, which is what keeps it from becoming
a type system (SC-2, SC-4).

compatible_from.description: Producer contracts this one accepts unconverted; empty at v4.0 (SC-3, SC-8).

id.description: The namespaced id; identity is the id, not the shape (decision S7).
